sentences.sentence: Eddie was introduced to Annika and Dr.Webber.
The team was told to check in for their flight.
A jaguar was spotted by Eddie.
Some large creatures were seen flying in the distance.
The birds were mistaken for Pterosaurs.
The flying creatures were identified as jabiru storks.
The anaconda was caught by Dr.Webber.
A photo of the anaconda was taken by Eddie.
